name: review-verdict
description: Structured review pass/fail verdict for cli-builder-team reviewer step. Return this schema when the coordinator requests a review decision.

verdict.description: Overall verdict: PASS proceeds to Docs, FAIL triggers loop-back.

status.description: PASS = ok, FAIL = blocking, WARN = noted but not blocking.

description.description: What was checked and what was found.

step_to_fix.description: Step number to loop back to for a FAIL: 1=plan, 2=test, 3=implement. Null for PASS/WARN.
